title: When Support Crosses the Line: Evaluating Ethical Boundaries in LLM-Based Mental Health Support in the Chinese Context
abstract: arXiv:2610.38452v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for mental health support, yet existing benchmarks primarily focus on supportive capabilities rather than whether models consistently adhere to professional ethical boundaries. This issue is particularly important in multi-turn interactions, where users may introduce new information or exert emotional pressure over time. We introduce MindEth-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating ethical boundary adherence in multi-turn mental health interactions. Grounded in professional ethical standards for mental health services in China, MindEth-Bench covers multiple dimensions of ethical conduct and uses Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to systematically explore interaction trajectories that stress-test model boundaries. translated_title: 当支持越界：在中国语境下评估基于大语言模型的心理健康支持中的伦理边界
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被探索用于心理健康支持，然而现有基准主要关注支持能力，而非模型是否持续遵守专业伦理边界。这一问题在多轮交互中尤为重要，因为用户可能会随着时间推移引入新信息或施加情感压力。我们提出了MindEth-Bench，一个用于评估多轮心理健康交互中伦理边界遵守情况的基准。该基准立足于中国心理健康服务的专业伦理标准，涵盖伦理行为的多个维度，并使用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）系统性探索交互轨迹，以对模型边界进行压力测试。在九个大语言模型上的实验表明，最初回应得当的模型在长期交互中可能逐渐转向违反伦理的行为，且不同模型之间存在显著差异。
tldr: 提出了基于中国心理健康专业伦理标准的MindEth-Bench基准，利用蒙特卡洛树搜索评估九个大语言模型在多轮心理健康交互中对伦理边界的遵守情况，发现模型在长期交互中可能从恰当回应滑向违反伦理的行为。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MindEth-Bench, a benchmark grounded in Chinese professional mental health ethics that uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to evaluate LLMs' adherence to ethical boundaries in multi-turn mental health interactions, revealing that models initially responding appropriately can drift toward ethical violations over extended interactions.
